copy.tagline: 设计后端架构、优化API与数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用Node.js或Next.js构建后端服务
copy.tagline_en: Design backend architecture, optimize APIs and databases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build backend services with Node.js or Next.js

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会提供后端架构模式、API 设计、数据库优化和服务器端最佳实践的代码示例与指导，涵盖 Node.js、Express 和 Next.js API 路由。
howto.when: 当你询问或设计 REST/GraphQL API、实现仓库/服务/控制器层、优化数据库查询、添加缓存、设置后台任务或构建中间件时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 RESTful API 端点，用于列出活跃市场。
say.note: Claude 会给出资源型 URL 和查询参数示例。

say.text: 如何用仓库模式封装 Supabase 数据访问？
say.note: Claude 会展示接口定义和实现类。

say.text: 写一个带指数退避的重试函数。
say.note: Claude 会提供 fetchWithRetry 代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude provides code examples and guidance on backend architecture patterns, API design, database optimization, and server-side best practices for Node.js, Express, and Next.js API routes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about or design REST/GraphQL APIs, implement repository/service/controller layers, optimize database queries, add caching, set up background jobs, or build middleware.

say_en.text: Help me design a RESTful API endpoint to list active markets.
say_en.note: Claude will show resource-based URLs and query parameters.

say_en.text: How to encapsulate Supabase data access with repository pattern?
say_en.note: Claude will provide interface and implementation class.

say_en.text: Write a retry function with exponential backoff.
